method: Every spawns[] entry rendered at 480x300 through the full post chain at pixelRatio 1, pixels of all spawns pooled, then mean and 5th percentile of sRGB-ENCODED luminance 0-255 (Rec.709 weights, no linearisation). This is the domain of the table in docs/PHASE-B-OBSERVATIONS.md and is NOT comparable to tools/luminance.py, which reports linear-light values over a different population.
harness: Playwright headless Chromium with --use-angle=d3d11 --enable-gpu --ignore-gpu-blocklist. The default headless GPU is SwiftShader, which post.js's capable() rejects -- a run without these flags silently measures with no post chain. Spawn yaw is asserted against the raw JSON degrees on every frame.
